decisions.reason: Having survived the first post-launch review and showing no visible failure, this close-to-core carpet is likely still around aspiration, though prior pruning of other carpets keeps some withdrawal risk from overlap and resource reallocation.

Management is still more likely to retain this close-to-core carpet because there is no clear evidence of underperformance, but its similarity to other carpet launches and the firm's demonstrated willingness to prune the category raise the risk somewhat.

This chair line is likely to be kept because its multiple models provide broader market application and learning value, and as a surviving core-adjacent launch it appears less likely than the carpets to fall below aspiration and be cut.
